mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT classroom.id AS class_id, classroom.organization_name AS class_name FROM edu_student_organization membership JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = membership.student_id AND student.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization classroom ON classroom.id = membership.organization_id WHERE membership.student_id = #{studentId} AND membership.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND classroom.status = 'ENABLED' AND classroom.effective_status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY classroom.organization_name, classroom.id

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scores.points DESC) AS rank_no, scores.points FROM ( SELECT student.id, COALESCE(SUM(ledger.amount), 0) AS points FROM edu_student student LEFT JOIN growth_point_ledger ledger ON ledger.student_id = student.id AND ledger.source_organization_id = #{classId} AND ledger.source_type IN ('TEACHER', 'ORGANIZATION') AND ledger.change_type IN ('TASK_REWARD', 'CORRECTION') WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization membership JOIN sys_organization classroom ON classroom.id = membership.organization_id WHERE membership.student_id = student.id AND membership.organization_id = #{classId} AND membership.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND membership.status = 'ACTIVE' AND classroom.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND classroom.status = 'ENABLED' AND classroom.effective_status = 'ENABLED' ) GROUP BY student.id ) scores ORDER BY points DESC
